thread.title: Google Colab released an extension for VS Code
thread.content: <document version="2.0"><paragraph>Lot's of us like to use VS Code as an IDE especially if we're using Copilot so I thought it might be helpful to other students to know that Google Colab recently released an extension that connects VS Code to the Google Colab runtime. </paragraph></document>
thread.document: Lot's of us like to use VS Code as an IDE especially if we're using Copilot so I thought it might be helpful to other students to know that Google Colab recently released an extension that connects VS Code to the Google Colab runtime.
